title: Tool calls
subtitle: Can a local model call a tool the way an agent needs? Thirteen request shapes agents send all day, scored on what the daemon returned: the right tool, the right arguments, the right number of calls, and no call when none is needed.
modelsHint: Only models that report tool support are listed first; others can be ticked too.
run: Run {n} cases on {m} model | Run {n} cases on {m} models

results.title: Results
results.legend: Each cell is one case for one model. Hover for the sentence; click for what the model returned.

detail.title: What the model returned
detail.noContentCall: no answer text: the model answered with the call, which is what a correct tool call looks like
detail.thinking: What the model thought first (returned by the daemon)

saved: Last run kept in this browser. Running again replaces it.
foot: What this page does not know: whether a tool call would have worked once executed. It judges the call itself, against the schema the model was given, the way a framework does before running anything. Temperature 0, non-streaming, through /api/chat.
